svg.title: Allocate Startup Cash Without Hiding Vendor Float
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-capital-allocation; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Allocate Startup Cash Without Hiding Vendor Float; subtitle: Four buckets total $75,000 within the $25,000–$150,000 range.; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: numeric_value encodes the $75,000 planning allocation. Matching low-capital allocations total $25,000 and high-capital allocations total $150,000, as detailed in each bucket. These are startup capital envelopes, not the Conservative, Base, and Scaled annual revenue scenarios.; caption: Startup cash funds timing differences and operating readiness; it is not revenue. First deals may take 3–12 months, so recalculate runway against actual spending and vendor terms.; stages: label: Vendor settlement float; value: $30,000 planning allocation; 40.0% of startup cash; numeric value: 30000.0; detail: Low envelope: $10,000; high envelope: $60,000. Cover the gap between vendor payment and customer settlement. Do not accept orders whose uncovered exposure exceeds available cash and confirmed credit capacity.; label: Operating cash reserve; value: $20,000 planning allocation; 26.7% of startup cash; numeric value: 20000.0; detail: Low envelope: $7,000; high envelope: $40,000. At the canonical $5,000–$25,000 monthly operating range, this $20,000 reserve covers 4.0 to 0.8 months before receipts, excluding separately allocated vendor float.; label: Vendor enablement and delivery; value: $15,000 planning allocation; 20.0% of startup cash; numeric value: 15000.0; detail: Low envelope: $5,000; high envelope: $30,000. Fund required certifications, documented demonstration environments, deployment runbooks, and limited specialist preparation for the chosen product family.; label: Commercial systems and setup; value: $10,000 planning allocation; 13.3% of startup cash; numeric value: 10000.0; detail: Low envelope: $3,000; high envelope: $20,000. Establish CRM, quote templates, accounting integration, insurance, contract review, and focused account research without committing to broad paid acquisition.

rect.title: label: Vendor settlement float; numeric value: 30000.0; value: $30,000 planning allocation; 40.0% of startup cash; detail: Low envelope: $10,000; high envelope: $60,000. Cover the gap between vendor payment and customer settlement. Do not accept orders whose uncovered exposure exceeds available cash and confirmed credit capacity.
